description: Defines classes and enums for project configuration, including ProjectType, ProjectConfig, and related data classes, as well as a TemplateConfigProvider for loading and processing template configuration files.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types, including frontend frameworks, backend frameworks, and databases.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration details for a project, including name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters, with methods for deriving default values and replacing parameters in templates.

classes.name: BuildCommand
classes.description: Represents a build command and its working directory.

classes.name: InstallDependenciesCommand
classes.description: Represents a command to install dependencies and its working directory.

classes.name: EnvironmentConfig
classes.description: Holds environment setup details such as versions of tools and whether the environment is initialized.

classes.name: ConfigureEnvironment
classes.description: Represents a command to configure the environment.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: Represents a command to run a tool.

classes.name: TestTool
classes.description: Represents a command to run tests.

classes.name: OpenapiGenerationTool
classes.description: Represents a command for OpenAPI generation.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains all information needed for initializing a project template, including commands, environment, files, and scripts.

classes.name: TemplateConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides functionality to load and process template configuration files, replacing parameters and returning a structured initialization info object.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Converts a string to a ProjectType enum value.

methods.name: get_replaceable_parameters
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of parameters for template replacement based on project configuration.

methods.name: replace_parameters
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in content with actual parameter values.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Loads and processes the template configuration file, returning a TemplateInitInfo object.
